to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Enterprises; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
105
Issuance of ration cards to
eligible persons
*341. PROF. ANIL KUMAR
SAHANI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has issued any
instructions to State Governments for
taking penal action against the staff for
issuance of Antyodaya Anna Yojana  (AAY)
and Below Poverty Line (BPL) ration cards
to bogus/ineligible persons;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
number of ration cards cancelled by the
State Governments; and
(c) the action taken to issue ration cards
to eligible poor persons?
Funds to States for implementation
of RTE Act
*342. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Chief
Minister of Gujarat had written a letter to
Prime Minister in January, 2010 for
introduction of Free Compulsory
Education to children as a National Project
by the Union Government;
(b) whether other State Governments
have also written to the Central Government
for providing more funds for smooth
implementation of the Right of Children to
Free and Compulsory Education (RTE)
Act, 2009; and
(c) if so, the concrete steps taken by
Government in this regard?

106
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Complaints of ragging received on
UGC helpline
*343. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of complaints received
on UGC helpline about ragging so far during
the current academic year;
(b) the number of cases out of them,
which have been investigated, with the
findings in each case and the action taken
thereon; and
(c) the number of cases of deaths and
suicides that have happened this year due
to ragging the findings of inquires, if held,
in those cases and the action taken against
students involved therein and the
authorities, if found, indifferent and
negligent?
Universities under consideration for
grant of minority status
*344. SHRI RAASHID ALVI: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of universities in the
country which have been granted minority
status; and
(b) whether any other university is
under consideration of Government for
grant of minority status?
Charging of more freight from Indian
farmers
†*345. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more freight
is being charged from Indian farmers for
transportation of essential food
commodities whereas less goods
transportation charge is being taken from
foreign farmers for the same goods;
(b) if so, the reasons for adopting this
dual policy;
(c) since when this practice of providing
benefit to foreign farmers is going on; and
(d) the details thereof?
Fine Arts colleges
†*346. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has prepared
any plan to increase the number of Fine
Arts colleges in the country;
(b) the latest rules and guidelines to set
up Fine Arts colleges;
(c) whether it is a fact that there are
only a few Fine Arts colleges in the country
and students are also not showing interest
in Fine Arts;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details of Fine Arts colleges in
the country functioning properly at
present?
Development and improvement of
railway services in Uttar Pradesh
*347. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) the areas/places in Uttar Pradesh
where railway services/functioning need to
be improved and developed further;
(b) the details of plan, estimates and
preparations made for the same;

107
(c) the targets fixed in each case;
(d) the details of demands received for
development and improvement of railway
services in Uttar Pradesh during the last
year and the current year so far; and
(e) the action being taken in all these
matters?
Workers under the Mid-Day-Meal
Scheme
*348. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Mid-Day-Meal
workers/cook-cum-helpers working under
the Mid-Day-Meal Scheme, State-wise;
(b) the number of Mid-Day-Meal
workers being paid an honorarium of
` 1000/- per month as announced in
November, 2010, State-wise;
(c) whether Government will agree to
pay minimum wages to these cooks and
cook-cum-helpers;
(d) if so, the time-frame thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Fake letter-pads of VIPs used for
confirmation of tickets
*349. SHRIMA TI
